kai: CI e2e perf gate failed on PR #4321 — p95 jumped from ~300ms to 520ms on the canary run. Anyone proximate? https://ci.internal/runs/98765
maria: saw same in nightly earlier, p99 also spiked. logs point at KV cache miss bursts around iteration 120-130. cc @sam
perf-ci-bot: [automated] e2e-perf-gate: FAILED
  metrics: p95=520ms p99=820ms (threshold p95<=400ms)
sam: on it. can we rerun the CI job first (might be a transient infra blip)?
lee: if rerun fails, can we bisect commits between 123abc..456def — there's a batching change landed yesterday
sam: rerun kicked: https://ci.internal/runs/98766 (started)
perf-ci-bot: Rerun 98766 started by sam
maria: quick check — commit 234bdec toggled continuous_batcher.min_samples from 1 -> 4, that could bump tail latency for short sequences
kai: good catch. that change would hold requests longer to form batches; for short seq workloads that's visible in p95
sam: running a local repro: ./scripts/e2e_run --seq=32 --warmup=0
sam: local output: p95=510ms, seems consistent with CI
lee: hold bisect for now, let rerun finish. if rerun passes, mark as flake and follow up on batching config
perf-ci-bot: Rerun 98766 finished — PASSED
kai: rerun passed, so probably transient or infra. but nightly still shows failures so we should investigate scheduling/cluster rollout patterns
maria: created INF-987 and attached logs + command to reproduce. assigning to eng-runtime oncall
sam: filing small PR to add a short warmup to the e2e job to reduce variance. will link when ready
lee: thanks — if INF-987 points to batching config, we should consider feature-flagging the change for canaries only
sam: noted. closing this thread for the immediate CI red. will follow up in INF-987 and the PR :thumbsup:
